Only a separator - this box does nothing. The settings below are for special cases and rarely need changing.

How much the Junkyard Sentinel build menu asks for (turrets, sensor post, alarm lamp, spike barricade). Hard: twice the material and skill levels of Normal, Very hard: three times, Extreme: four times (skills at most 10). Tools stay the same. From Hard on, these things can only be built from the build menu, not from the crafting menu.
Owner and members of the owner's safehouse
Who can switch, configure and pick up a turret: only the owner, the owner and members of his safehouse, or everyone. Admins can always use the admin menu.
Harpoon: spears land on the ground
If on, every fired spear lands next to the target and can be picked up again. If off, fired spears are used up.
Harpoon turret: maximum range in tiles.
Active turrets one player can own. Extra turrets stay switched off. 0 = no limit.

Turrets and sensors already recognise NPCs of Project A-Life, Bandits, Roaming Survivors, Stay With Me and other mods using the common markers. For another NPC mod, add the marker its bodies carry, separated by ; - an animation variable by name (e.g. MyNpcMod) or a mod data key as md:Key.

Only matters with an NPC mod (Project A-Life, Bandits, Roaming Survivors and others). What turrets do with NPCs unless the owner picks something else in the turret menu. Non-hostile means friendly or neutral towards the turret owner (companions, recruits, friendly survivors); hostile NPCs (raiders, hostile bandits) are shot. NPCs of mods the turret does not know count as non-hostile.
Rifle turret: maximum distance to a target in tiles.
Junk Spike Barricade: damage to zombies

Damage a zombie takes from the spikes each second while it touches the barricade - striking it or walking past (0 = none). A zombie has about 1 health: 0.02 = dead after about 50 seconds of contact, 0.04 = about 25 seconds.
How much each barricade tile takes before zombies break it. A stick fence has 200. Applies to barricades built from now on.
Only a separator - this box does nothing.
Shotgun turret: maximum distance to a target in tiles.
Sniper turret: maximum range in tiles. Hard cap is 30.

Sets damage, accuracy and instant kills of all turrets (normal zombie: 1.0 health). Weak: damage x0.6, -15 percent hit chance, no instant kills - rifle needs 3-5 hits. Realistic (default): base values, 5 percent instant kills - rifle 2-3 hits. Strong: damage x2, +3 percent, 15 percent instant kills - rifle 1-2 hits. Very strong: damage x3.5, +5 percent, 30 percent instant kills - almost always 1 hit. Extreme: damage x6, +10 percent, 75 percent instant kills. Lethal: every hit kills, +15 percent.
Universal Gun Turret: accept vanilla weapons

On (default): vanilla rifles, shotguns and the like work in the Universal Gun Turret too (useful on servers without a gun mod). Off: it only takes weapons from gun mods; vanilla firearms belong to the Sentinel Turrets. Pistols and revolvers never work.
Weapons the turret refuses, separated by ; - e.g. MarzGuns.AA12;MarzGuns.M60 or a whole mod with MarzGuns.*
The turret fires with the values of the weapon in it, measured against a vanilla weapon of the same class and the turret strength above. This multiplies the damage on top (1.0 = as calculated).
Universal Gun Turret: machine gun damage bonus (percent)
Machine guns (M60, BAR and the like) deal this much more damage per round. They already fire at their real rate of fire in long bursts.
A weapon can deal at most this many times the damage of the matching Sentinel Turret (1.5 = 50 percent more). Keeps very strong mod weapons in check.
Only a separator - this box does nothing.
If on, turrets need no ammo at all. Single shots or bursts are set on each rifle turret (right-click > Settings).
Two-tile spike rack. Blocks zombies and wounds every zombie that touches it. Right-click it to repair. Durability and damage are sandbox options.
Key for the list of your sensor networks (admins: all networks).
